material_findings: The pinned PRIOR_HISTORY is incomplete relative to the protocol requirement to preserve V1-through-V11 protocol and review history: it pins the V1 rejection but omits the V1 protocol and review packet, and it pins only protocol/review-packet files for V2 through V6 while omitting their rejection receipts. validate_prior_history therefore cannot detect mutation or replacement of those omitted history records. The explicit V10 rejection and V11 acceptance plus pre-effect execution failure are pinned, and the V10 source-prefix/path and canonical metric/bootstrap-order defects are closed, but the broader required history gate remains open.
rejection_reasons: Complete the pinned V1-through-V11 historical record set before requesting another review; do not create undocumented historical receipts.
